question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 2.
solution: The correct answer is** Option (2) i.e. 'ample'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Trees provide **abundant (**प्रचुर**) resources**, which aligns with the meaning of '**ample**'(प्रचुर). • The use of '**ample**' matches the context of discussing the various significant benefits trees offer. • 'Ample' suggests a plentiful amount or supply, which is suitable for describing the benefits mentioned. **Therefore, the correct answer is 'ample'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** __ • '**Minor**' means smaller in amount, size, or importance. • '**Acute**' suggests severe but of short duration. • '**Less**' indicates a smaller amount or not as much. Complete Passage is: Trees are one of the gifts of the nature which are of great importance__ for all living beings and environment. They have __ample__ benefits to living beings providing natural herbs, vegetables, fruits, wood, timber, etc. Trees are the ______ of many birds and insects. They are also considered as the ______ part of the atmosphere which help in reducing pollution. Conserving trees and spreading awareness to plant trees will save the atmosphere from depletion and ______ survival of all forms on earth. 18a:Tf4d,
